content:
Apple has rolled out the 5th beta of iOS 27 today, along with related updates, and surprisingly also released a second wave of betas including iOS 26.6.1, macOS 26.6.2, and more.

iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1, and macOS 26.6.2 betas debut simultaneously

If you've been running Apple's beta software, you've got two options today.

The 5th beta of iOS 27 finally arrived three weeks later, continuing Apple's summer-long preparation for its next major software release.

But Apple has also just dropped a new round of betas for iOS 26 and related updates.

The first betas of iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1, and macOS 26.6.2 are now officially out.

It's unusual for Apple to offer betas for such small software updates. The company typically just rolls out minor fixes without prior notice.

These updates may be intended to replace larger ones like iOS 26.7. But whatever the reason, Apple clearly feels the need to test these iOS 26 updates before releasing them to the public.

iOS 26.6.1 and similar updates are expected to contain only security patches and bug fixes. We'll keep you posted if we spot any specific changes.

Note: If you've already upgraded your iPhone to the iOS 27 beta, you won't see an option to install iOS 26.6.1. This update is only available for devices still running iOS 26.

Are you still on iOS 26? Have you noticed anything different in the iOS 26.6.1 beta? Let us know in the comments.
